items.title: Pay therapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: This is a private invoice between individuals/a private provider, not an administrative act, so the statutory delivery-fiction rules (§122 AO / §41 VwVfG / §37 SGB X) do not apply; instead the plain BGB period-counting rules apply. The period runs 'nach dem Rechnungsdatum' (after the invoice date), so per §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date, 18.11.2026) is excluded and counting starts on 19.11.2026 as day 1. 21 days later (day 21) falls on 09.12.2026 (19.11.2026 + 20 days = 09.12.2026). §188(2) BGB confirms the period ends with the expiry of the day which by its designation corresponds to the day of the triggering event, i.e. 21 days after 18.11 = 09.12.2026. 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed.
